## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No real credentials, PII, internal endpoints, or customer content are included.
- [ ] Breaking behavior and migration guidance are documented.
- [ ] False-positive, false-negative, latency, and data-egress effects were considered.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] `bin/ci` passes.
- [ ] The Rails Appraisal matrix passes when Rails or generator code changes.
- [ ] RubyCritic's 95-point and strict per-file gates pass.
- [ ] Ruby syntax checks pass.
- [ ] README, API reference, examples, and changelog are updated when needed.
